https://ryanuo.cc/navs: 站点的技术导航页，把散落在浏览器收藏夹里的链接整理成一页能翻的目录。链接按类别分进标签页，学习资料、组件库、工具，还有一个「最近使用」会记住你上次点过哪些，想找什么切到对应页签就行。每个条目是一张卡片，带图标、名称和一句简介，点击在新标签页打开。列表由数据驱动，增删条目只改配置。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/vtable: 文章从一个很多人答错的问题开场：new 出来的对象在堆上，虚函数表是不是也在堆上？不在。它不跟着对象走，住在只读数据段里，程序加载时就定好了。vtable 是编译器为每个含虚函数的类生成的函数指针数组，全类共用一张，表头还放着 type_info 指针给 RTTI 用；vptr 则是藏在对象开头的隐藏指针，指向那张表。文章顺着一次调用走了查表、取偏移、间接跳转的过程，解释了派生类为什么有自己的表、析构为什么必须是虚的、多继承时 this 为什么要偏移。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/grill-me-vs-s: This post compares two agent-skill approaches that people treat as either-or: grill-me, Matt Pocock's short interview-style skill, and Superpowers, Jesse Vincent's full software methodology. The real overlap is pre-implementation alignment; the differences show up in shape, enforcement and lifecycle coverage. grill-me is a few sentences: it interrogates your plan relentlessly until you reach shared understanding, follows a decision tree to resolve dependencies, reads code where that answers the question, and suggests an answer for every prompt. It stays small and optional, and by default writes nothing. Superpowers welds a delivery pipeline into the agent — design, plan, implement, review, finish — with skills that force the agent not to take shortcuts. The post walks through positioning, origins, workflows, and mechanism differences such as invocation style, interview depth, coverage and learning curve, then closes with pros, cons and selection advice.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/grill-me-vs-supe: 文章对比 Agent Skills 生态里绕不开的两个项目：Matt Pocock 的 grill-me 和 Jesse Vincent 的 Superpowers。很多人当成二选一，作者认为重叠点在「动手前对齐」，差别在产品形态、强制程度和覆盖的生命周期。grill-me 是三四句话的审讯式 skill，按决策树追问到共享理解，默认不落盘。Superpowers 把整套工程流程焊进 agent：设计、计划、实现、评审、收尾，用 skill 强制不走捷径。文章逐条拆解定位、工作流、机制差异和成本，最后给出选型建议。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/ai-text: This guide is about what to do before handing a long document to a language model. Models advertise huge context windows, yet long inputs still hurt: cost grows with tokens, inference slows down, proxies impose smaller limits, and very long requests fail with 503s and timeouts. Worse, raw documents are full of tokens that carry no meaning — Markdown syntax, HTML tags, image links, repeated navigation blocks. The post first compares two crude approaches: truncating by message count, which is simple but may drop the part that mattered, and truncating by token count, which respects the limit but deletes redundancy and signal alike. It then argues that summarization is not deletion but raising information density, and lays out a four-stage pipeline: cleaning Markdown, normalising text, extractive summarization with SnowNLP or TextRank, and generative summarization by an LLM only where the cheap stages left something worth condensing.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/ai-text: 这篇讲的是把长文本交给大模型之前该做什么。模型动辄宣称支持几十万 Token 的上下文，但成本随 Token 上涨，长上下文让推理变慢，第三方代理限制更死，超长请求还容易抛 503 或超时。更麻烦的是原始文档塞满了不承载信息的 Token，Markdown 语法、HTML 标签、图片链接、重复导航都算。文章先对比按消息条数和按 Token 长度两种截断，再说明摘要不是删字而是提高信息密度，最后给出四阶段流水线：Markdown 清洗、文本规范化、抽取式摘要，最后才用 LLM 生成摘要。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/ai-dev-though: A working developer's reflection on the AI wave, written for people who are not founders or investors and simply want to know whether their income, job security and options will improve. The author rejects both loud narratives — that AI will replace developers, and that anyone who does not learn it will be left behind — and reframes the question practically. He admits he was anxious when ChatGPT first became popular, then describes trying the tools and finding one simple thing: AI writes code, but it does not know what you want to build, whether the requirement makes sense, why users need the feature, or how to debug it when it breaks. His conclusion is that AI replaces low-value work before it replaces jobs. If your value is moving data between spreadsheets, an assistant does it in minutes; if your value is understanding the business, spotting problems and pushing projects forward, AI becomes leverage.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/ai-dev-thoughts: 一个普通开发者写下的 AI 观察，写给每天面对工作和收入、既不是创业者也不是投资人的普通人。文章先否定两种极端说法：AI 来了工作就没了，不学 AI 就会被淘汰。作者把问题改成更现实的问法——收入会不会变高，工作会不会更稳。他坦白自己也焦虑过，真用了之后发现：AI 会写代码，但不知道你要做什么，需求合不合理、方案贴不贴合业务、出错怎么排查还得靠人。他的判断是 AI 最先淘汰的不是职业而是低价值工作，能理解业务和推动项目的人反而多了一个助手。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/mac_emd: 在 M 芯片的 Mac 上做嵌入式，第一道门槛是电脑和开发板怎么连上。CH340 转接器插上后会以 tty.wchusbserial 之类的名字出现，但第一次通常认不出来，得先装 WCH 官方的驱动，装完再 ls 就能看到设备。串口工具可以用 SecureCRT 的 Mac 版，也可以用 Termius 这类更轻的终端。真正麻烦的是交叉编译：M 芯片上的编译链版本比开发板高，而开发板 glibc 太旧，链接就报错。文章给了两条路，一是换 armv7l 目标编译链并先确认开发板的 glibc 版本，二是在 Ubuntu 虚拟机里用 Docker 拉 16.04 镜像挂载源码编译，用容器隔离版本差异。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/embedded: An overview of what to know before starting embedded development with a Linux flavour. It begins with the layering: an embedded system splits into application, kernel and hardware layers, and beginners underestimate how much of the work sits in the middle. The knowledge stack is listed concretely — Linux file system layout, the shell commands you actually use, users and permissions, editing with Vim, and building a shared environment. A short section records an installation trap: installing an Ubuntu server ISO on a Mac, picking the latest release avoids display-adaptation problems older images have, the desktop can be added afterwards with one apt install and a reboot, and 3D acceleration is unavailable on Apple Silicon. The bulk is reference material: what each top-level directory from /bin to /var is for, file commands grouped by reading, writing and searching, and Vim's modes with their movement and editing keys.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/diamond-inherita: 菱形继承是面试常问、平时又容易写错的一块。文章先把形态铺开：单继承是一条链；多继承时先继承的基类排在内存前面，派生类自己的成员放最后。当两个基类共同继承同一个顶层基类，继承图就成了菱形：第一个坑是二义性，Assistant 同时继承 Student 和 Teacher，两者各带一份 Person，a._name 指哪份编译器分不清，只能指定类域绕过去；第二个坑是数据冗余。解法是虚继承：在中间层继承顶层基类时加 virtual，编译器只保留一份共享的基类子对象并插入虚基类表指针定位它。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/mcp: A hands-on guide to the Model Context Protocol that takes you from zero to a working server in about ten minutes. It starts with vocabulary: MCP servers act as bridges that expose APIs, databases or code as tools; clients speak the protocol to those servers; and hosts — Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed, Cody — manage the exchange between the two. The point is that a server written once can be used by any host, instead of every integration being rebuilt for every assistant. The walkthrough then builds one: create the project and install the TypeScript SDK, write the server code that registers capabilities, define a tool with its name, description and input schema, compile it, and register the binary in the host's configuration. The final example wraps a public REST API as an MCP tool, the pattern most real integrations follow, and calls it from the host to confirm the round trip.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/mcp: 手把手在十分钟内搭出一个能用的 MCP 服务器。开头讲清概念：MCP 是模型上下文协议，由三块组成——服务器把 API、数据库或代码封装成工具暴露出去，客户端用协议和服务器通信，主机则是 Claude Desktop、Cursor 这类管理数据交换的宿主。协议的价值在于一次编写、处处可用。接着是步骤：新建项目、装 TypeScript SDK、配好 package.json 和 tsconfig、写注册能力的基础代码、定义工具入参、编译，再登记到主机配置里。最后把公开的 REST 接口包装成工具。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/gpt: A walkthrough of a small Flask project that turns GPT into a service usable from a browser or a chat app. The backend exposes REST endpoints: chat, which takes a model name and message list and returns the completion; image generation, which turns a prompt into a picture URL; a WeChat endpoint handling messages from an official account including auto-replies and image requests; and summarisation, which takes an article URL and returns a condensed version. The front end is deliberately plain so the focus stays on the API. The write-up covers environment setup, the variables that must be present — the WeChat token, an optional API key and base URL for a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint — how to start the app locally, and how to deploy to Vercel with routing that sends every path into the single Flask entry point, along with the project layout.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/gpt: 这是自己那个 GPT 小项目的完整说明。后端是 Flask，对外提供几组接口：对话接收模型名和消息数组返回生成内容，生图把一句描述变成图片地址，公众号接口处理关注者消息、支持自动回复和按需出图，摘要接口传一个网址进去返回压缩后的概括。前端做得刻意简单，重点在接口本身。文章把流程写得很细：克隆仓库、装依赖、准备环境变量（公众号 token、自定义接口的 Key 和地址），本地用 python -m api.index 起服务，再部署到 Vercel，并说明 vercel.json 把所有路径重写到同一个 Flask 入口的写法。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/forwardemail: A step-by-step account of getting a mailbox on your own domain without running a mail server. ForwardEmail is an open-source forwarding service: you keep the domain, point a couple of DNS records at their infrastructure, and every message addressed to your domain is relayed to a mailbox you already own. The prerequisites are short — a domain, an existing inbox, and an account. Then the configuration: sign up, add the domain in the dashboard, create the records it asks for, including two MX records at different priorities plus a TXT record proving you control the domain. DNS propagation takes minutes to hours. Forwarding rules come next, mapping an address such as hello@your-domain to a personal inbox. Finally send a test message and confirm it lands.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/forwardemail: 不用自己搭邮件服务器，也能用上自己域名的邮箱。ForwardEmail 是开源的转发服务：域名留在自己手里，把几条 DNS 记录指向它的基础设施，之后发到这个域名的信件都会转发到已有邮箱。准备工作只有三样：域名、收信邮箱、账号。配置流程是注册登录、在控制台添加域名、按提示添加两条不同优先级的 MX 记录和一条验证归属的 TXT 记录，DNS 生效要几分钟到几小时。然后设转发规则，把 hello@你的域名 指到个人邮箱，最后发一封测试邮件确认能收到。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/tmpl-cli: A command-line tool for pulling project templates straight out of Git repositories. The problem it solves is familiar: every new project starts with copying a folder, renaming things, deleting what you do not need, then discovering a forgotten placeholder. Template CLI replaces that with one command — point it at a repository, pick a template from an interactive list, and it clones, renames the target directory and leaves a clean starting point. Branch, target directory and template name can be passed as flags, so the same command works in scripts. A cache remembers repositories, branches and templates you used recently, so the second run is a single keystroke, with flags to inspect or clear it. There is also a JSON selection mode for templates described by a config file. The post documents installation, the parameter table and a workflow example.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/tmpl-cli: 一个用 Rust 写的命令行小工具，解决「新建项目要从老项目复制粘贴」的麻烦。每次开新项目都要复制目录、改名字、删掉用不上的文件，还常漏掉某个占位符。Template CLI 把这一串压成一条命令：指向一个 Git 仓库，交互式挑模板，工具克隆下来、重命名目标目录，直接得到干净起点。它支持用参数指定分支、目标目录和模板名，写进脚本也不会被交互卡住。最近用过的仓库、分支和模板会被缓存，第二次基本一个回车就完成。另有 JSON 选择模式，适合模板由配置文件描述的场景。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/aug: A beginner-oriented guide to buying gold, written around the flow you actually go through on a retail app. It uses JD Finance as the example: open an account, verify identity, link a bank card, transfer money into the gold balance, then buy by amount or weight at the real-time quote; selling credits the account immediately, a withdrawal to a bank card carries a small fee, and trading pauses on public holidays. The next section is the part beginners get wrong — the arithmetic of units and currencies. One troy ounce is about 31.1 grams, domestic quotes are in yuan per gram while international quotes are in dollars per ounce, so conversion is international price times the exchange rate divided by that constant, with a worked example. Then price monitoring, and why onshore and offshore prices differ.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/aug: 写给完全没接触过黄金的入门指南。以京东金融为例：下载 App、实名认证、绑卡，把钱充进黄金账户，再输入金额或克数按实时金价下单；卖出后资金回到账户，提现到银行卡收一点手续费，节假日休市。文章重点讲新手最容易搞混的换算：一盎司约 31.1 克，国内报价是元每克，国际报价是美元每盎司，所以国内金价等于国际金价乘汇率再除以这个常数。最后解释在岸和离岸价差为什么存在——税费、运输、汇率波动和进口政策都算在内。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/ollama: A guide to running a model locally on a Mac without babysitting two separate processes. The motivation is convenience: normally you start Ollama in one terminal, Open-WebUI in another, then open the browser yourself, and repeat after every reboot. The post builds one script that does all three and can be bound to an alias. Preparation comes first: a recent macOS, at least 8 GB of memory, optional GPU acceleration depending on the model, and a stable connection because the weights are large. Python 3.11 or 3.12, Ollama and Open-WebUI are installed, and a model is pulled. The script then starts Ollama with serve in the background, records the process id, starts Open-WebUI on a chosen port, and opens localhost in the default browser with a cross-platform command.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/ollama: 在 Mac 上跑本地大模型的部署记录，重点是把启动流程收拢成一条命令。平时跑 Ollama 和 Open-WebUI 要开两个终端，一个 serve 起服务，另一个起界面，再自己去浏览器输地址，每次重启都得重来。文章写的脚本一次执行完成三件事：后台拉起 Ollama 并记下进程号，指定端口启动 Open-WebUI，再调用系统命令打开浏览器，兼容 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。准备工作写得很实在：系统用较新的 macOS，内存至少 8GB，想要 GPU 加速得看机型，网络要稳因为要下权重。软件装 Python 3.11 或 3.12、Ollama 和 open-webui，模型用 pull 拉一个。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/cplusplus: C++ 入门最容易记混的两个关键字，文章用一张对照表讲透了。volatile 的作用是阻止编译器优化：每次读这个变量都必须从内存取，不能缓存到寄存器，典型用在硬件寄存器、中断标志和内存映射 I/O 这类会被程序之外改动的地方；register 反过来是请求把变量放进寄存器提高速度，但只是建议，现代编译器基本忽略。对照表指出：register 不一定生效，volatile 编译器必须遵守；register 不能取地址，volatile 可以；两者都不提供线程安全。后面接着讲内联函数：调用点直接展开，省掉压栈跳转。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/bitwise: 一篇把位运算从基础讲到实战的长文。开头用表格把六种运算符的规则和示例摆出来：与、或、异或、取反、左移、右移，再给三个口诀——与是清零取位判断，或是置位，异或负责翻转去重。接着重点讲异或的四条性质：零元、自反、交换律、结合律，推论是一堆数异或到一起时出现偶数次的数全部抵消，这是「只出现一次的数字」系列题的根基。避坑部分针对 C 语言：与、或、异或的优先级低于等于号，判断偶数必须加括号；移位位数超过类型位宽是未定义行为。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/database: 一份按知识点分层的 MySQL 速查手册。开篇先把概念立住：数据库是存储和管理数据的软件，用户必须通过 DBMS 访问，DBMS 提供四类语言——DDL 建库建表改结构，DML 增删改，DQL 就是 select，DCL 管权限和事务；管理层级是库到表到记录，记录是一行，字段是一列。然后按操作串下去：登录退出、库的查看创建删除和切换，并解释 if not exists 是为了避免重复执行报错。表的操作最实用：建表语法骨架、字段类型选择、六大约束各管什么，以及 ALTER TABLE 增删改列、改类型、重命名表和字段的写法，还有删除表与清空表的区别。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/pthread: 一篇把 Linux 并发从头捋到尾的长文。先区分进程和线程：进程是分配资源的最小单位，线程是调度执行的最小单位；同一进程的线程共享虚拟内存、代码段、堆和文件描述符表，但各自拥有线程 id、栈、寄存器和 errno。文章用表格对比多进程和多线程在资源共享、上下文切换、通信和可靠性上的差别。接着讲生命周期：create 创建、join 回收，返回值只能是常驻内存的值。同步部分最细：互斥锁与死锁规避、读写锁适合读多写少、条件变量必须配互斥锁并用 while 判断谓词。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/yunshu-uninst: A practical uninstall guide for a Mac client that does not go away when you drag it to the bin. The goal is stated up front: remove the Yunshu/EagleYun client, its background services, leftover directories and configuration files, without touching anything else on the system. Detection comes first, and the post provides a shell script checking four places — running processes matching the product name, launch daemons and agents that reference it, application support and hidden directories under /opt, and log folders and user preferences. Helper processes still running mean the service must be stopped before deletion. https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/file-download: A short post about a bug that looks like a browser quirk but is really about what the server tells the client. When a page builds a Blob and triggers a download, the filename comes from the download attribute or from the response headers. If that name has no extension, the saved file may end up with none either, which makes it unrecognisable to the operating system and awkward for users who then rename it by hand. The post explains the browser's default behaviour: if the name already contains what looks like an extension, it leaves it alone; if not, it may guess from the MIME type or the URL path, and different browsers guess differently, so behaviour varies by browser and platform. The recommended measures: always include a suffix, set Content-Type and Content-Disposition on the server, and keep the extension in the Blob's name.

The format section lays out the common convention: a type, an optional scope in parentheses, a colon, and a subject in the imperative mood, short and without a trailing period, followed by an optional body explaining motivation and a footer for breaking changes or issue references. The common types are enumerated with what each is for.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/git-commit: 把提交信息当成代码的一部分来对待，而不是走个形式。文章开头讲道理：一条好的提交信息能告诉协作者改了什么、为什么改，而 Git 的历史读的次数远多于写的次数，所以这笔投入很值。好处列得很直白：团队看得懂、排查回归时能在历史里搜到、能自动生成变更日志、评审时因为提前知道意图而更快。接着给格式：类型加可选的括号范围，冒号，然后用祈使句写一行简短的主题，结尾不加句号，后面可以跟一段正文说明动机，以及一段脚注标注破坏性变更或关联的 issue 编号。常用类型逐个说明用途，包括新功能、修复、文档、重构、性能、测试、构建和杂务。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/pinia: Detailed study notes on Pinia, written as a comparison with Vuex rather than a bare API reference. It starts with the trade-offs: Pinia has full TypeScript support, weighs about a kilobyte, dispatches actions as ordinary function calls instead of requiring dispatch and map helpers, supports multiple stores, and works with devtools, SSR and code splitting; its main missing feature is time-travel debugging, which Vuex offers. Vuex in turn has maturity and a strict mutation model, at the cost of more boilerplate. The notes then walk through usage: defining a store with the composition or options style, several ways to modify state including direct assignment and patch-style updates, why destructuring state breaks reactivity and how storeToRefs fixes it, how getters memoise derived values, how actions can be async, and how plugins extend every store.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/pinia: 这份 Pinia 笔记写成对照手册的形式，几乎每个知识点都跟 Vuex 摆在一起比较。开头是优缺点对照：Pinia 有完整的 TypeScript 支持、体积约 1KB、action 就是普通函数调用而不用 dispatch 和 map 辅助函数、支持多个 store、兼容 devtools、SSR 与代码分割；缺点是不支持时间旅行调试。Vuex 反过来，成熟、mutation 模型严格，但样板代码多。接着是使用部分：store 怎么初始化，state 里放什么，getter 怎么算派生值并缓存，action 里怎么写异步逻辑。改值给了几种方式，直接赋值最简单，改多个字段用 patch。解构 state 会丢响应式，解决办法是 storeToRefs。
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/embd_used_soft: 一份按工作流分类的常用软件清单，作者的说法是工欲善其事，必先利其器。浏览器部分列了插件和网页两类：插件里有沉浸式翻译解决看英文文档的问题，还有下载管理器接管浏览器自带的下载；网页则是一些常驻的在线服务。AI 提效工具单独一类，写文档、查资料、改代码时用得最多。代码编辑器除了本体还列了常用插件，覆盖格式化、语法检查、Git 集成。画图和文档类工具解决画架构图、写技术方案的需求。Git 相关工具包括图形化客户端和一些提效脚本，效率工具那一栏更杂，有快捷启动、剪贴板管理、窗口管理。每一项都带官网或下载地址，也标注了适用平台。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/bs2022: A graduation project write-up for a system that identifies pests on Chinese herbal medicine, presented as a case study rather than a paper. It starts with the demo: a video walkthrough and screenshots of the running application, so the reader sees the thing before reading how it was built. The architecture section splits the system into a front end, a back end and a model service, explaining what talks to what. The front end is Vue 3 with a component library, and the post lists the libraries chosen and why — routing, state, HTTP, charts, uploads — followed by the performance work that mattered on a real connection: CDN-hosted assets, Gzip, route-level code splitting and image handling. The back end is Flask, deliberately modular: each feature lives in its own blueprint, with shared configuration and error handling pulled out. The model section covers training a YOLO-v5 detector and how inference is called.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/bs2022: 这是毕业设计项目的完整说明，主题是中草药害虫识别，写法偏工程记录而不是论文。开头先放演示：一段视频走查和几张运行截图，让人先看到东西再听怎么做的。系统架构部分把整体拆成前端、后端和模型服务三块，说明它们之间怎么通信、数据怎么流转。前端用 Vue 3 加组件库，文章列出了选用的库和原因，接着是性能优化：静态资源走 CDN、开启 Gzip、按路由做代码分割、图片懒加载，这些在真实网络条件下降得很明显。后端是 Flask，按模块拆得很清楚：用户管理、图片上传、识别预测、历史记录各自一个蓝图，公共的配置和错误处理抽出来统一管，最后附上仓库地址。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/convolution: Notes on convolutional neural networks, built from first principles rather than starting with a framework. The opening answers the obvious question: why convolution at all? Compared with a fully connected layer, a convolutional layer has far fewer parameters, which makes high-resolution images trainable on modest datasets and reduces overfitting; and its structure encodes the assumption that nearby pixels matter together, so it extracts salient features while cutting dimensionality and compute. The post then works through edge detection with a 3x3 filter, showing why one filter responds to vertical edges and how positive and negative edges differ — the sign tells you the direction of the transition. Padding comes next, then stride, then 3D convolution for volumes such as video, and finally the familiar stack of convolution, activation and pooling layers.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/convolution: 卷积神经网络的学习笔记，从基本原理往上搭，而不是一上来就讲框架。开头回答一个必然会被问的问题：为什么要用卷积？跟全连接层比，卷积层的参数少得多，这样高分辨率图片在不算大的数据集上也能训练，过拟合的风险也随之降低；同时它的结构本身编码了「相邻像素有关系」这个假设，所以在提取显著特征的同时还能降维、减少计算量。接着用 3x3 的过滤器讲边缘检测，说明为什么某个过滤器对垂直边缘有响应，以及正边缘和负边缘在结果上的差别——符号表示的是亮度变化的方向。然后是填充、步长，再扩展到三维卷积，最后拼成卷积、激活、池化交替堆叠的结构。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/docker: A compact reference for Docker that covers concepts before commands. It defines the three nouns first: an image is an immutable template built from layers, with small base images such as alpine and fuller ones such as ubuntu; a container is a running instance created from an image, essentially a stripped-down Linux system with its own process tree, network namespace and filesystem; a repository is where images are stored and shared, public ones on a registry and private ones behind authentication. The principles section explains what makes this work: namespaces isolate processes, mounts and network stacks, while cgroups limit and account for CPU, memory and IO, so containers share one kernel and stay lighter than virtual machines. The rest is a command sheet grouped by object — container lifecycle and inspection, image build and prune, network and volume management.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/docker: 一份 Docker 速查，先讲概念再讲命令。三个名词先立住：镜像是不可变的模板，由多层叠加而成，常用的基础镜像有 alpine 这种极简的，也有 ubuntu 或各种语言运行时；容器是由镜像创建出来的运行实例，本质是一个精简的 Linux 系统，有自己的进程树、网络命名空间和文件系统；仓库是存放镜像的地方，分公有和私有两类。原理部分解释了它为什么能跑起来：命名空间负责隔离进程、挂载点和网络栈，cgroups 负责限制和统计 CPU、内存与 IO，所以容器共用一个内核，比虚拟机轻得多。后面是命令清单，按对象分组，容器、镜像、网络、卷各有几条常用命令并标注使用场景。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/pytorch: A beginner's path into deep learning with PyTorch, starting from concepts and only then touching code. It first separates machine learning from deep learning on two axes: feature extraction, which a human designs in classical machine learning but the network learns automatically in deep learning, and data volume, where classical methods work with small datasets and deep networks need a lot more. The application list is concrete — image recognition including detection and face verification, machine translation, speech recognition, chat — which gives a sense of why the field took off. Neural networks are introduced as mathematical models that imitate biological networks, used to approximate functions, and the perceptron as the smallest unit that makes a decision from weighted inputs. The practical half then walks through tensors: creation, shapes, dtypes, devices and the everyday operations.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/pytorch: 一份从概念讲到代码的 PyTorch 入门笔记。开篇先把机器学习和深度学习分开，用的是两个维度：特征抽取，机器学习靠人工设计特征，深度学习则由网络自动学习；数据量，传统方法在较小的数据集上就能工作，深层网络则需要多得多的样本。应用场景列得很具体：图像识别包括物体检测和刷脸认证，机器翻译、语音识别、对话系统，这些例子能解释清楚这场技术浪潮为什么会起来。神经网络被介绍成一种模仿生物神经网络的数学模型，用来逼近函数，感知机则作为最小的决策单元出现，讲清了输入加权、求和、激活这几步。后半部分是张量的创建、形状查看和常用运算。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/es6: Notes on ES6 modules and asynchronous JavaScript, taught together because they end up used together. The module part starts with context: AMD, CMD and CommonJS were the earlier non-standard approaches, and ES modules replaced them with import for bringing things in and export for sharing them out, with one line in the package manifest telling the runtime to treat files as modules. Three usages follow: a default export with its matching default import, named exports and imports where the names must agree or can be renamed with as, and side-effect imports that only execute the file. The Promise part explains the object as a placeholder for a future value, then covers chaining with then, error handling with catch, the all method for waiting on several at once, and the race method for taking whichever settles first.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/es6: 把 ES6 模块化和异步编程放在一起讲，因为实际项目里两者总是连着用。模块部分先交代背景：AMD、CMD、CommonJS 是早年的非标准做法，ES6 用 import 引入、export 导出取代了它们，还需要在 package.json 里声明 type 为 module，运行时才会按模块处理。三种用法依次讲：默认导出配默认导入，名字可以自己取；按需导出导入，名字必须一致，想换名就用 as；以及直接导入，只执行文件不取任何值。Promise 部分把它解释成「未来值」的占位符，然后讲链式 then、用 catch 处理错误、all 等待多个任务、race 取最先完成那个，以及把回调式 API 包装成 Promise 的常见写法。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/re-soup: A crawling write-up organised around the four tools it uses, with a finished project as the backdrop. The regular expression section is the longest: it explains re.match for matching from the start, re.search for finding anywhere in the string, re.sub for replacement, re.compile for precompiling a pattern that is reused, findall for all matches, finditer for an iterator of match objects when you need positions, and split for cutting a string on a pattern, each with a short example. Modifiers such as case-insensitive and multiline are covered, along with why raw strings matter when patterns contain backslashes. XPath comes next: selecting nodes by tag, attribute, position and text, and how developer tools let you test an expression against a live page before putting it in code. BeautifulSoup is presented for its tolerant parsing.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/re-soup: 围绕四种工具组织的爬虫实战笔记，背后是一个已完成的项目。正则部分写得最细：match 从头匹配，search 在整串里找第一次出现，sub 做替换，compile 预编译便于复用，findall 一次拿到所有结果，finditer 返回匹配对象迭代器、需要位置信息时用它，split 用模式切分字符串，每种都配了短例子。修饰符讲了忽略大小写和多行模式，以及为什么写正则要用原始字符串。接着是 XPath：按标签、属性、位置、文本内容选节点的语法，并说明可以先用开发者工具在真实页面上试表达式。BeautifulSoup 被推荐的理由是容错性强。最后附了项目仓库和部署方式。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/sass: A working tour of Sass written for someone who already writes CSS and wants less of it. The opening defines the tool: a preprocessor for CSS whose files use the scss extension, installed globally with npm and run on a file to produce an output stylesheet. The syntax section starts with variables, including the detail that a variable can be built from other variables. Nesting follows: selectors nest inside one another so the DOM structure is visible in the stylesheet, and the ampersand connects pseudo-classes to the parent rather than producing a descendant; property nesting is covered too. Mixins come next as reusable blocks that take arguments, contrasted with extend, which shares declarations between selectors rather than copying them, and import for splitting styles across files. The final part covers number, string and colour functions and lists.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/sass: 写给已经会写 CSS、只想少写一点的人的 Sass 笔记。开头先定义：它是 CSS 的预处理器，文件后缀是 scss，用 npm 全局安装，命令行给一个输入文件就产出对应的输出样式表，也可以挂进构建的监听模式里。语法从变量讲起，包括一个变量可以用另一个变量拼出来这个细节，示例里定义一个主色再到处复用，改一处就全站生效。嵌套讲了两层：选择器之间嵌套，让样式表结构和 DOM 对应；用 & 符号连接伪类，让它作用在父选择器本身而不是后代，这一点很多人写错。接着是 mixin 可以带参数复用一段声明，extend 在多个选择器间共享同一组声明，import 把样式拆成多个文件。最后是数字、字符串、颜色函数和列表。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/js-re: A practical walkthrough of regular expressions in JavaScript, organised by the problems you actually meet. It begins with extracting digits from a mixed string, first showing the non-regex route of splitting into an array and filtering with isNaN, then the regex route of matching with a global pattern and joining the result. From there it covers building a pattern from a variable, either by constructing a RegExp object from a string or by evaluating a pattern string, and notes the escaping pitfalls of the first approach. Selectors and groups come next: alternation, character classes, groups for capturing and back-referencing, anchors, and the word-boundary and whitespace metacharacters. Then the modifiers — global, case-insensitive, sticky — and an explanation of lastIndex and how it changes repeated exec calls, with replace, test and exec compared at the end.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/js-re: 一份 JavaScript 正则的实战笔记，按遇到的问题组织，而不是照着语法表罗列。开头从字符串里提取数字：先给不用正则的做法，把字符串拆成数组再用 isNaN 过滤，虽然能跑但冗长；再用正则的全局匹配加 join，一行就完成，意图也更清楚。接着讲用变量拼正则，一种是用 RegExp 构造函数从字符串创建，另一种是求值一个模式字符串，并提醒第一种方式里反斜杠要双层转义，这是高频坑。选择符和分组部分讲了或的分支、字符类的范围和取反、分组的捕获与反向引用、首尾锚点，以及单词边界和空白元字符。然后是全局、忽略大小写、粘性三个修正，lastIndex 单独解释一段，最后把 replace、test、exec 放在一起对比。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/java: Notes from a Java course, covering overloading, recursion and the first steps of object orientation. Overloading gets a full treatment: the benefits are that you remember fewer method names and can ignore automatic type conversion in several cases; the definition is several methods with the same name in one class that differ by parameter types, count or order; the rules require them to be in the same class, with identical names and different parameter lists, and note that return type and modifiers do not participate in the decision. Recursion is introduced as a method calling itself, with a base case and a reducing step, demonstrated on a simple sum and then on Fibonacci, first recursively and then with a loop to show the cost. Base conversion is a second exercise. The closing section introduces classes and objects, and what lives on the stack versus the heap.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/java: 一份 Java 课程的整理笔记，覆盖方法重载、递归和面向对象的开头部分。重载讲得最完整：好处是少记方法名，很多情况下不用关心参数的自动类型转换；定义是同一个类里出现多个同名方法，靠参数类型、个数或顺序来区分，调用时按实参决定走哪个；规则强调必须在同一个类里、方法名相同、参数列表不同，并明确指出返回值类型和修饰符不参与重载判断，这条最容易记错。递归必须有终止条件和不断向终止条件靠近的递推步骤，文中用累加和斐波那契演示。最后开始讲类和对象、构造方法以及 JVM 的内存管理。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/tkinter: A catalogue-style introduction to building desktop windows with tkinter, the GUI toolkit that ships with Python. It opens by justifying the toolkit: a console program that only reads and writes text has no user experience to speak of, and a window with buttons and fields is what makes a small tool usable by someone else. The pattern for every widget is stated once: create the main window, give it a title and a geometry, instantiate the widget with its parent and options, lay it out with pack or place, then enter mainloop so the window keeps refreshing instead of flashing and closing. The Label section demonstrates text, background colour, font family and size, and width and height measured in characters. From there each widget gets a short section with the essential options and a minimal snippet.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/tkinter: 一份清单式的 tkinter 入门笔记，讲的是 Python 自带的桌面界面库。开头先说明为什么需要它：一个只从终端读入、输出文字的程序谈不上用户体验，加了按钮和输入框的小窗口，别人才能用得起来。然后是所有控件共通的那套流程，文章只讲一遍：先创建主窗口，设标题和尺寸，实例化控件时指定父容器和各项参数，用 pack 或 place 把它放上去，最后进入 mainloop 让窗口持续刷新，否则窗口一闪就关。Label 部分演示了文本、背景色、字体和字号，以及宽高是以字符为单位而不是像素。接下来每个控件一节：Button 带回调，Entry 单行输入，Text 多行编辑，Listbox 列表选择，Scale 滑块，Canvas 画布，Menu 菜单，messageBox 对话框，每节都给了关键参数和示例。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/buy-car: A personal account of buying a first car, structured like a case study rather than a review. It starts with the reasons, sorted from practical to emotional: convenience of leaving whenever you want, easier family trips, the general upgrade in quality of life, and the freedom to explore, before admitting the real trigger — the household genuinely needed a car and the author had been working for a bit more than a year. The budget section fixes a ceiling under 150,000 yuan and picks a domestic sedan on grounds of value for money and appearance, with a 2.0T engine and a deliberate choice of petrol over electric because of range anxiety at that price. A comparison table pits the chosen model against four rivals. The closing chapters describe test drives, negotiating the price and the final out-the-door figure.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/buy-car: 一篇第一辆车的购车记录，写法像复盘而不是车评。开头先列理由，从实用到情绪都有：随时出发的便利，家庭出行更轻松，生活质量的整体提升，还有自由探索的乐趣，最后才说实话——家里确实需要一辆车，而工作一年多也攒下了一些钱。预算那节把上限定在十五万以内，选了国产轿车，理由是性价比高、外观合眼缘；配置上选 2.0T 图动力，明确不选电车，因为在这个价位上对续航有焦虑，掉一点电就想充。接着是一张对比表，把选中的车型和四款同价位竞品放在一起，比外观内饰、智能配置、动力和价格区间。试驾那节记录了每台车开起来和坐进去的感受。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/2021: A New Year essay that works through the things people actually worry about, one section at a time. It opens with anxiety, and the diagnosis is simple: we are anxious because the person we are and the person we imagine being are far apart, and that gap grows because we keep letting ourselves down. The pattern is described precisely — staying up late but only scrolling, buying vocabulary books that are never opened, collecting workout plans and never starting, saving articles to a drive that fills up unread. The point is not that collecting is bad but that time spent gathering is time not spent digesting. The remedy is blunt: the way to beat anxiety is to do the thing that makes you anxious, now. Later sections cover dreams and effort, money, relationships, family, reading, choices and the future in the same tone.
https://ryanuo.cc/posts/2021: 一篇新年长文，按主题一节一节把真正会焦虑的事讲开。开头是焦虑，诊断很简单：焦虑来自现在的自己和想象中的自己差得远，而这个差距是被一次次辜负自己拉开的。文章把这个怪圈写得很具体：每天熬夜却只是刷手机点赞，心血来潮买一堆单词书再没翻开，被刺激后收藏一堆健身攻略却从没动过，把有用的东西另存为直到硬盘塞满。作者指出问题不在收藏本身，而在于花在收集上的时间本该用来消化。解法很直接：打败焦虑的办法就是去做那件让你焦虑的事。后面依次讲梦想与奋斗、金钱、人际、爱情和未来。
https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/git: Beginner Git notes, written as a reference you keep open in a second window. It opens with what Git is: a distributed version control system created by Linus Torvalds to manage the Linux kernel, capable of handling projects from tiny to enormous, and it defines the three names beginners trip over — the default development branch, the default remote, and the pointer to the current commit. Configuration comes first in practice: set the user name and the email attached to every commit, with the global flag so it applies everywhere.
